page.overview:
Who is Caira?

Caira was a spacer who worked with Melvirre. An expert on ancient Hutt folklore and culture, Caira enthusiastically pointed out kucha-sculpts that decorated the walls of Terman Station. Caira believed that if they were genuine, they would be worth a fortune.
